beats.vo: That "am I doing this right?" voice is what's pulling you out of the moment.
beats.visual_intent: Pencil ticking boxes on a checklist, close-up, dim light, no people.

beats.vo: Nerves turn your first time into something you're watching and grading, instead of something you're actually in. You're checking how you look, how long it's been, whether she can tell you're new. And the more you grade yourself, the more anxious you get.
She isn't grading you the way you are. And arguing with that voice won't shut it up.
beats.visual_intent: Warm lamp-lit room corner, calm, dark tones, no people.

beats.vo: When you catch that voice, switch to one thing you can physically feel right now.

overlay.text: Switch to one thing you can feel.

beats.visual_intent: Two hands loosely holding, warm low light, no faces, no jewelry if possible.
search_queries: holding hands close up warm light

beats.vo: Her hand in yours. Your own breathing. How warm the room is.
beats.visual_intent: Steam rising from a mug, warm light.

beats.vo: Grading keeps you in your head. Feeling keeps you in the room.
beats.visual_intent: Calm room in warm, dim light, no people.
